### `POST /api/projects/{project_id}/document-sources/git-repo`

**Start Git Repo Import**

Import a git repository's docs + source files at a pinned commit
(licence + commit recorded per document). 202 + Job by default; 201 +
summary inline.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | `path` | `integer` | yes |  |
| `async_job` | `query` | `boolean` | no |  |

**Request body** (required)

Content type: `application/json` — `GitRepoRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | `string` | yes |  |
| `ref` | `string` | no |  |
| `include_globs` | `string[]` | no |  |
| `exclude_globs` | `string[]` | no |  |
| `default_excludes` | `boolean` | no |  |
| `max_file_bytes` | `integer` | no |  |
| `max_files` | `integer` | no |  |

**Responses**

| Status | Schema | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | `any` | Successful Response |
| `422` | `HTTPValidationError` | Validation Error |
